title: Drive Radio — August 7, 2026
description:
- US strikes $1.2B deal to pay German firm to halt offshore wind projects: The government paid nine figures just to make sure a wind farm never gets built — a wild snapshot of current energy politics. (https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1e1vg0gjl5o)
- Mario Meets Pareto: A viral deep-dive applies the 80/20 rule to Super Mario level design and accidentally explains why some games just feel better. (https://www.mayerowitz.io/blog/mario-meets-pareto)
- AMD acquires Taalas to boost inference performance by etching models in silicon: AMD's buying a startup that literally burns AI models into chips — a bold bet on speed over flexibility. (https://www.theregister.com/systems/2026/08/06/amd-acquires-ai-chip-startup-taalas-to-boost-inference-performance-by-etching-models-into-silicon/5284344)
- New Mexico court orders Meta to pay $567m over harms to children's mental health: A landmark ruling that's small money for Meta but potentially huge legal precedent. (https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/aug/06/new-mexico-court-meta)
- Radical Study Suggests Life on Earth Arose Twice: New research suggests life may have sparked from non-living matter more than once — reshaping how we think about life elsewhere in the universe. (https://www.sciencealert.com/radical-study-suggests-life-on-earth-arose-from-non-living-matter-twice)
- U.S. economy lost 23,000 jobs in July, a sudden reversal: A confusing jobs report where the headline number and the real story point in opposite directions. (https://www.nbcnews.com/business/economy/july-2026-jobs-report-rcna591138)

title: Drive Radio — August 6, 2026
description:
- Changes at Google DeepMind: Hassabis to Chair, Jeff Dean departs: A surprising leadership shakeup at the peak of Google's AI momentum raises questions about what's really happening behind the scenes. (https://blog.google/company-news/inside-google/message-ceo/next-chapter-ai-momentum/)
- DeepSeek planning to significantly raise prices: The AI disruptor famous for dirt-cheap models is about to prove that cheap AI was never actually free. (https://platform.deepseek.com/usage)
- Humans missed 1 in 3 threats approving AI agent commands across 40k game runs: A wild new stat shows human oversight of AI agents might be more theater than safety net. (https://scalex.dev/blog/ai-agent-permissions-stats/)
- Discovery Loop: The addictive new curiosity rabbit-hole site that ate Hacker News' entire day. (https://www.discoveryloop.com/)
- Crime Pays but Botany Doesn't: A botanist's reading list on why plant science gets no love became an unlikely hit — and a metaphor for underfunded, unglamorous work everywhere. (https://www.crimepaysbutbotanydoesnt.com/reading-list)
